title: Indian Army Technical Entry Scheme (TES 52)
description: Indian Army invites applications from unmarried male candidates who have passed 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM) subjects for the grant of Permanent Commission in the Army.

title: Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 33rd Course
description: Applications are invited from unmarried male and unmarried female LAW GRADUATES for grant of Short Service Commission in the Indian Army for Judge Advocate General Branch.

title: Indian Navy Agniveer (SSR) - 02/2024 Batch
description: Recruitment of Agniveer (SSR) for the 02/2024 batch. Candidates must have qualified in 10+2 with Maths & Physics and at least one of these subjects: Chemistry/Biology/Computer Science.

title: Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2024
description: Indian Air Force invites Indian citizens (Men and Women) to be part of this elite force as Group A Gazetted Officers in Flying and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches.

title: DRDO RAC Scientist 'B' Recruitment
description: Recruitment and Assessment Centre (RAC) invites online applications from graduate engineers and post graduates in Science for recruitment to the post of Scientist B in DRDO.

title: Indian Army - Religious Teacher (Junior Commissioned Officer)
description: Indian Army invites applications for recruitment of Religious Teachers as Junior Commissioned Officers for RRT courses 91, 92, 93, 94 & 95. Candidates must be spiritually inclined and meet the educational qualifications for the specific religious denomination.

title: Security Officer (Ex-Servicemen)
description: Hiring for the post of Security Officer. Only Ex-Army/Ex-Defence personnel (JCO/NCO) should apply. Responsibilities include managing security operations, training guards, and ensuring safety.

title: Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant (CGCAT)
description: The Indian Coast Guard, an Armed Force of the Union, offers a challenging career to young and dynamic Indian male/female candidates for various branches as an Assistant Commandant (Group ‘A’ Gazetted Officer).

title: Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 56th Course
description: Indian Army invites applications from unmarried male and female graduates, including Wards of Battle Casualties of Army Personnel, for grant of Short Service Commission in the Indian Army.

title: Security Supervisor - Ex Army Personnel
description: A leading facilities management company is seeking Ex-Army personnel for the role of Security Supervisor. Must have a strong sense of discipline and experience in security management.
